newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-GelTex started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-GelTex started at buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of GelTex Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating and a one-year target price range in the low $30s.
-- Vector cited the fact that GelTex's two proprietary products, designed to treat chronic kidney failure and to reduce cholesterol, are in late development stage.

-- A New Drug Application filing for the two drugs is planned for the fourth quarter of 1997, Vector said. Vector also estimated that sales of RenaGel and CholestaGel will reach about $500 million each in 2002.
-- GelTex also has $73 million in cash, which reduces the prospect of dilutive financings, Vector said.
-- GelTex develops non-absorbed, polymer-based drugs that bind to and eliminate target substances from the intestinal tract.
-- The company's shares were up 1/4 Wednesday at 20-3/4.
